name: How long does a bathroom tub installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom tub installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathtub replacement in an existing layout generally takes two to three days. However, a full bathroom remodel that includes framing changes, custom tile surround installation, or drywall repairs often requires five to seven days. The total schedule depends on whether the plumbing drain and supply lines stay in their existing locations or must be moved. When tile surround or moisture-resistant drywall is added around the new tub, additional time is needed for thin-set mortar, grout, and paint to cure properly before the tub can be used.
acceptedAnswer.description: A direct tub swap typically takes 2 to 3 days, while projects involving new tile surrounds, plumbing moves, or drywall finishing usually take 5 to 7 days.
